S001.angle: Slightly front-facing view into the hand mirror, aligned to preserve correct mirror reversal of Mikko's anatomical left cheek.
S001.framing: Close composition centered on the clean hand-mirror reflection, with Mikko's reflected face large enough to clearly read all three berry smudges. Include enough of Lumi's hands and partial presence to show that she is holding and angling the mirror.

dialogue.speaker: Mikko
dialogue.text: Berries on my face! I want to feel fresh.

dialogue.speaker: Lumi
dialogue.text: I see three little smudges.

S002.angle: Straight-on or slight three-quarter angle consistent with S001, maintaining readable facial marks and the mirror as a held prop.
S002.framing: Medium view of Mikko and Lumi in the same neutral setting. Mikko, the cloth, Lumi, and the hand mirror remain readable.

dialogue.speaker: Mikko
dialogue.text: Where shall I try first?

S003.angle: Over Mikko’s shoulder, angled toward the mirror so the reflected face and all three marks remain readable.
S003.framing: Close over-shoulder composition from behind or slightly beside Mikko, showing Mikko’s face and the mirror reflection together.

dialogue.speaker: Lumi
dialogue.text: Let’s look for one little spot.

S004.angle: Over Lumi’s shoulder toward the mirror, maintaining continuity with S003 and keeping Mikko’s reflection oriented consistently.
S004.framing: Close over-shoulder mirror view showing Lumi’s hands and the mirror reflection of Mikko’s face, with the selected cheek mark readable.

dialogue.speaker: Lumi
dialogue.text: A glint on his cheek!

dialogue.speaker: Lumi
dialogue.text: Find the next smudge!

S005.angle: Front-facing close angle aligned with the mirror reflection; maintain a readable, unobstructed view of the cheek mark and clean mirror glass.
S005.framing: Steady face-and-mirror composition showing Lumi holding the mirror and a clear reflected view of Mikko’s marked anatomical left cheek.

S006.angle: Front three-quarter angle aligned so the physical cheek and its mirror reflection can be compared without ambiguity.
S006.framing: Close face-and-mirror composition showing Mikko’s face, the selected cheek, Lumi’s hand-held mirror, and the reflected cheek mark clearly.

dialogue.speaker: Mikko
dialogue.text: This cheek. I’ll try a gentle wipe.

S007.angle: Front three-quarter angle consistent with the preceding face-and-mirror view; preserve the selected cheek orientation.
S007.framing: Clear cheek-focused view including Mikko’s hand, the soft cloth, and enough facial context to identify the anatomical left cheek.

dialogue.speaker: Mikko
dialogue.text: Wipe your cheek with me. Soft and slow.

dialogue.speaker: Mikko
dialogue.text: Can you pretend to wipe your cheek?

S008.angle: Same face-to-mirror angle and screen orientation as S007.
S008.framing: Locked close view matching the cheek composition established in S007; the selected cheek, stationary cloth, and enough of the mirror/reflection context remain readable.

S009.angle: Three-quarter facial angle matching the selected cheek and the previous shot’s readable cheek orientation.
S009.framing: Unbroken close view of Mikko’s cheek and the nearby lower-face area, with the cloth passage clearly readable.

S010.angle: Slightly front-facing angle toward the mirror, aligned with the reflection rather than looking at the mirror glass as a dirty surface.
S010.framing: Close view of the tiny hand mirror and Mikko’s reflected face, composed so the clear anatomical left cheek and the two remaining smudges are simultaneously readable.

dialogue.speaker: Lumi
dialogue.text: That cheek is clear. Two smudges left.

S011.angle: Eye-level three-quarter angle that preserves the established mirror readability and keeps Mikko’s anatomical left cheek consistent.
S011.framing: Relaxed two-shot with Mikko and Lumi both readable and the mirror face visible enough to confirm the clear cheek and remaining smudges.

S012.angle: Slight over-shoulder angle from Lumi’s side toward Mikko and the mirror surface; keep the reflection readable without showing a dirty mirror.
S012.framing: Close two-character mirror-view composition, prioritizing Lumi’s mirror angle and the reflected mouth-area berry mark while retaining enough of Mikko’s face and lowered cloth to show the action.

dialogue.speaker: Lumi
dialogue.text: By your mouth!

dialogue.speaker: Lumi
dialogue.text: Find the next smudge!

S013.angle: Mirror-facing angle that clearly shows the reflected mouth-area mark while retaining enough of Lumi’s hand and Mikko’s lowered cloth for continuity.
S013.framing: Close, steady view centered on the hand mirror reflection and the visible skin beside Mikko’s closed mouth.

S014.angle: Front-facing angle aligned with the mirror reflection; keep Mikko’s face and the reflected target area visually consistent with S013.
S014.framing: Clear close face-and-mirror view, with Mikko’s closed mouth and the small smudge beside it readable while Lumi’s mirror remains visibly held and angled.

dialogue.speaker: Mikko
dialogue.text: I’ll slow my hand. One little wipe.

S015.angle: Front-facing angle aligned with the established mirror composition; keep the cloth contact area unobscured.
S015.framing: Close face view centered on the mouth-area mark and the approaching cloth, with enough surrounding facial area to confirm the nose mark remains and the cheek is clear.

S016.angle: Aligned with the mirror reflection from the established setting and lighting; preserve the readable reflection angle from S015.
S016.framing: Close view centered on the tiny hand mirror and its reflection, with enough surrounding face context to read the cleared cheek and mouth area and the remaining nose mark.

dialogue.speaker: Lumi
dialogue.text: That spot is gone. One is left.

S017.angle: Established front-facing angle with the mirror visible between the characters.
S017.framing: Medium two-shot matching the established setting and lighting; Mikko and Lumi, the hand mirror, and Mikko's reflection remain readable.

S018.angle: Mirror-aligned reflection angle, matching the established mirror composition while tightening scale.
S018.framing: Begin on the approved episode artwork with Lumi adjusting the mirror, then cut to a tighter macro reflection showing enough of Mikko’s nose contour to identify the final smudge.

dialogue.speaker: Lumi
dialogue.text: One spot left!

dialogue.speaker: Lumi
dialogue.text: Find the next smudge!

S019.angle: Match the reflection angle established at the end of S018.
S019.framing: Maintain the macro view of the clean mirror glass and Mikko's reflection, with the remaining nose smudge clearly visible.

S020.angle: Front-facing conversational angle aligned with the mirror so the nose smudge and both cleared areas are readable in Mikko's face and reflection.
S020.framing: Close face view including Mikko's face, the clean mirror reflection, Lumi's mirror-holding presence, and the cloth moving toward Mikko's nose.

dialogue.speaker: Mikko
dialogue.text: My nose! I’ll wipe just that spot.

S021.angle: Front-facing angle comparable to the opening and final mirror compositions, with Mikko’s face and reflected face aligned clearly.
S021.framing: Unbroken close face view of Mikko with Lumi’s tiny hand mirror visible enough to establish the reflection and final cloth contact.

S022.angle: Front-facing angle aligned with the established mirror view; keep Mikko’s face and reflected face visually consistent with the prior shot.
S022.framing: Close facial detail including Mikko’s nose, cheek, mouth area, the lowered cloth hand, and enough of Lumi’s mirror-holding presence to establish the observation.

dialogue.speaker: Lumi
dialogue.text: Your nose is clear, too.

S023.angle: Three-quarter angle toward Mikko and the mirror, preserving the established opening/final mirror composition relationship.
S023.framing: Medium view of Mikko facing the hand mirror, with Lumi’s supporting hand and partial presence readable in frame.

S024.angle: Front-facing mirror angle, aligned for a comparable opening/final composition.
S024.framing: Close view matching the saved opening mirror composition, including Mikko’s face and mirror reflection.

S025.angle: Match S001's established camera angle and mirror angle; preserve the comparable opening/final transformation view.
S025.framing: Matched mirror composition from S001, showing Mikko, Lumi's mirror hold, and Mikko's clean reflection.

dialogue.speaker: Lumi
dialogue.text: Cheek, mouth, nose. All clear.

S026.angle: Front-facing angle consistent with the established mirror composition and the clean-reflection continuity from S025.
S026.framing: Medium two-shot including Mikko’s clear face, the cloth held away from his face, Lumi, and the hand mirror.

dialogue.speaker: Mikko
dialogue.text: One little spot at a time!
